CustomProperties.Name: AssigneeEmail
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Mail of the chosen person. This is the identity the flow acts on; AssigneeName is display only.

CustomProperties.Name: AssigneeName
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Display name of the chosen person, for your toast and audit text.

CustomProperties.Name: AssignmentKey
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The AssignmentKey of the task being rerouted. The component looks the record up in the RequestAssignments LIST itself, on the indexed AssignmentKey, so nothing else about the task needs passing in. It reads the list rather than a collection because this component has instances on BOTH My Tasks and Details, so it must not depend on any one screen's state.

CustomProperties.Name: Mode
CustomProperties.Tooltip: temporary or transfer. A temporary delegation returns to the original assignee afterward; a transfer moves the task permanently. These are keys, never the button labels.

CustomProperties.Name: OnCancel
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the user dismisses the dialog by the scrim, the close button or Cancel. Clear your open flag here AND call Reset() on this instance, or the next open still shows this person and reason.

CustomProperties.Name: OnSubmit
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the user confirms. Read Mode, AssigneeEmail, AssigneeName and Reason and call your flow from here, then call Reset() on this instance once the dialog closes. The component never calls a flow and never writes to a data source.

CustomProperties.Name: Reason
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Why the task moved. Required, because a reroute is something that happened to someone else's work and the audit trail is the only place it is explained.
